notes: Adds a per-minute flood guard to the Free Service Gateway API: when Auto-block is enabled in Gateway Settings, an IP sending more than 3 requests in a single minute is now rejected (429) and blocked immediately, using the same escalating block-duration rules as the other auto-block triggers. This targets rapid-fire flooding/DDoS-style abuse specifically, on top of the existing daily-volume and oversized-payload triggers. Auto-block must be turned on in Gateway Settings for any of these to actually block IPs - if the panel is unreachable, it can be enabled directly via phpMyAdmin (see chat). No database update needed for this update.
